verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gitea has an API, a go-sdk and a CLI, but none of it documents a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate spec path on docs.gitea.com returned 404. Having an API is adjacent and does not count as a published machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
